description: Slack notification blocked due to plugin:productivity:slack requiring authentication. Skill instructions state 'read master-slack skill and send to #golf', but Slack connector unavailable in non-interactive session. Fallback written to working memory but primary deliverable (Slack notification) not sent.
correction: The skill should not assume Slack is available during non-interactive scheduled runs. Either (a) pre-authorize all required connectors before scheduling, or (b) build fallback into skill itself that writes to memory and signals a retry.
systemic_fix: Update golf-preview SKILL.md to explicitly address non-interactive execution: add a note that plugin:productivity:slack must be pre-authenticated, and provide a fallback routine that writes to memory/working/ and logs error to eval harness. Also update the scheduled-task instruction block to verify connector availability before invocation.
